action: Dragos recommends rotating administrator and VPN credentials, especially on FortiGate appliances, enforcing MFA on all remote access, auditing for administrator accounts not created internally, and patching edge devices rapidly.
exec: Dragos counts ransomware on industrial firms up from the previous quarter, with manufacturing the largest share; edge devices and stolen VPN credentials are among the ways in.
plain: Security firm Dragos counted 1,266 ransomware attacks on factories and other industrial companies in three months, 11% more than the previous quarter. Ways in included internet-facing equipment and stolen VPN passwords.

key_findings: Dragos tracked 1,266 ransomware incidents affecting industrial organisations in Q3 2026, up 11% from 1,140 in Q2.
Manufacturing accounted for 876 incidents (69%); North America had 566, of which 473 were in the United States.
Qilin claimed 195 victims and The Gentlemen 167; distinct ransomware brands hitting industry rose from 70 to 99.
Entry came through internet-facing edge devices and enterprise applications, often within days of disclosure, and stolen VPN credentials.
Cl0p returned with 35 victims via PTC Windchill and FlexPLM exploitation; no operator was seen manipulating a control system directly.
recommendations: Rotate administrator and VPN credentials, especially on FortiGate appliances.
Enforce MFA on all remote access.
Audit for administrator accounts you did not create.
Patch edge devices and enterprise applications rapidly and run continuous external attack surface management.
Enforce strict policies for remote monitoring and management tools.

summary: Dragos recorded 1,266 ransomware incidents affecting industrial organisations in the third quarter of 2026, up 11% from 1,140 the quarter before. Manufacturing took 69% of them and the United States 37%. According to Dragos, Qilin led with 195 incidents, ahead of The Gentlemen (167 claimed victims) and Cl0p (35). Dragos names exploited edge devices and enterprise applications, and stolen VPN credentials, among the ways in. Dragos saw no operator directly manipulate an industrial control system.
title: Dragos counts 1,266 ransomware incidents at industrial organisations in Q3 2026
